Resolves non-melanoma cell subtypes using compartment-specific clustering, reference mapping and marker-based annotation.

**Inputs:** Annotated cells from Xenium notebook 01, the skin reference atlas in `paper_data/Xenium/reference_atlas`, and manual subtype annotations in `paper_data/Xenium/inputs`.

**Outputs:** Compartment-specific annotations and reference predictions in `data/`; reference-label recovery metrics and clustering feature lists in `results/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Set these root folders before running the notebook.
data_root <- 'path_to_input'
output_root <- 'path_to_output'
code_root <- 'path_to_code'

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                    cache = FALSE, cache.lazy = FALSE, fig.align = 'center')
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = code_root)

```

```{r load_libraries}

library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

outdir <- file.path(output_root, 'Xenium')
intermediate_dir <- file.path(outdir, 'data')
result_dir <- file.path(outdir, 'results')
data_dir <- file.path(data_root, 'Xenium')
input_dir <- file.path(data_dir, 'inputs')
atlas_dir <- file.path(data_root, 'Xenium', 'reference_atlas')
subtype_dictionary <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, 'manual_lineage_subtypes.csv'))
for (path in c(outdir, intermediate_dir, result_dir)) {
  dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v5', future.globals.maxSize = 50 * 1024^3)
future::plan('sequential')

```

## Non-melanoma subtypes

Reference-label recovery was assessed using the genes shared with the Xenium panel. Final labels also considered marker expression and tissue location; unreliable reference distinctions were merged or replaced by marker-based annotations.

### Myeloid clustering

```{r myeloid_clustering}

obj <- readRDS(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'annotated.rds'))

# initial myeloid cells
sub <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$main_lineage == 'Myeloid'])
counts <- LayerData(sub, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'counts')
features_use <- names(which(Matrix::rowMeans(counts > 0) >= 0.05))

# PCA
sub <- RunPCA(sub, features = features_use, npcs = 30, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)

# embedding and clusters
sub <- RunUMAP(sub, dims = 1:8, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)
sub <- FindNeighbors(sub, dims = 1:8, verbose = FALSE)
sub <- FindClusters(sub, resolution = 0.8, algorithm = 1, random.seed = 0, verbose = FALSE)

```

```{r reference_recovery_helpers}

reference_recovery_metrics <- function(prediction, labels) {
  counts <- table(prediction$labels, labels)
  metrics <- data.frame(cell_type = intersect(rownames(counts), colnames(counts)))
  metrics %>% mutate(TP = counts[cbind(cell_type, cell_type)], truth_n = colSums(counts)[cell_type], predicted_n = rowSums(counts)[cell_type], recall = TP / truth_n, precision = TP / predicted_n, F1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
}

reference_holdout <- function(expression, labels, seed = 1234) {
  set.seed(seed)
  groups <- split(seq_len(ncol(expression)), labels)
  test <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(index) sample(index, max(1, floor(0.2 * length(index))))), use.names = FALSE)
  list(test = test, train = setdiff(seq_len(ncol(expression)), test))
}

predict_holdout <- function(expression, labels, split) {
  SingleR::SingleR(test = expression[, split$test, drop = FALSE], ref = expression[, split$train, drop = FALSE], labels = labels[split$train], de.method = 'wilcox', fine.tune = TRUE, num.threads = 8)
}

```

### Myeloid reference recovery

```{r myeloid_reference_recovery}

library(SingleR)
ref <- as(Matrix::readMM(file.path(atlas_dir, 'ref.mtx')), 'CsparseMatrix')
rownames(ref) <- readLines(file.path(atlas_dir, 'genes.txt'))
atlas_labels <- readLines(file.path(atlas_dir, 'labels_detailed.txt'), encoding = 'UTF-8')

# myeloid reference
subtypes <- c('Mono', 'Mac', 'LC', 'CD1C+ DC', 'CLEC9A+ DC', 'CCR7+ DC')
selected <- which(atlas_labels %in% subtypes)
reflab <- atlas_labels[selected]
refM <- as.matrix(ref[, selected])

# held-out cells
split <- reference_holdout(refM, reflab)
prediction <- predict_holdout(refM, reflab, split)

# subtype recovery
metrics <- reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, reflab[split$test])
write.csv(metrics, file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_myeloid.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Myeloid annotation

Reference transfer was retained, but monocytes were merged with macrophages because the panel lacks monocyte-specific markers; CD1C+ DC was renamed cDC2 because CD1C is not measured. Marker expression overruled cluster 6 to B cells (CD79A/MZB1) and cluster 13 to pDC (IL3RA/IRF8).

```{r myeloid_annotation}

atlas <- list(expression = refM, labels = reflab, atlas_index = selected)

# atlas projection
expression <- LayerData(sub, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'data')
common <- intersect(rownames(expression), rownames(atlas$expression))
prediction <- SingleR(test = expression[common, ], ref = atlas$expression[common, ], labels = atlas$labels, aggr.ref = TRUE, fine.tune = TRUE)

# annotations
sub$Myeloid_label <- prediction$labels
sub$Myeloid_label[sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8 %in% 6] <- 'B.Lymphocyte'
sub$Myeloid_label[sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8 %in% 13] <- 'pDC'
sub$Myeloid_label[sub$Myeloid_label == 'Mono'] <- 'Mac'
sub$Myeloid_label[sub$Myeloid_label == 'CD1C+ DC'] <- 'cDC2'
saveRDS(sub, file.path(intermediate_dir, 'myeloid_annotated.rds'))

```

### Endothelial clustering

```{r endothelial_clustering}

# endothelial cells
sub <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$main_lineage == 'Endothelial'])
features_use <- names(which(Matrix::rowMeans(LayerData(sub, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'counts') > 0) >= 0.05))

# PCA
sub <- RunPCA(sub, features = features_use, npcs = 30, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)

# clusters
sub <- FindNeighbors(sub, dims = 1:5, verbose = FALSE)
sub <- FindClusters(sub, resolution = 0.8, algorithm = 1, random.seed = 0, verbose = FALSE)

```

### Endothelial reference recovery

HEC and VEC were poorly distinguished by the panel, so they were merged for reference transfer. HEC identity was then restored only in clusters 6 and 8, which showed high SELE expression.

```{r endothelial_reference_recovery}

# endothelial reference
selected <- which(atlas_labels %in% c('VEC', 'LEC', 'HEC'))
reflab <- atlas_labels[selected]
refM <- as.matrix(ref[, selected])

# held-out cells
split <- reference_holdout(refM, reflab)
prediction <- predict_holdout(refM, reflab, split)
metrics <- reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, reflab[split$test])
write.csv(metrics, file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_endothelial.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

# merge HEC and VEC
lookup <- c(HEC = 'VEC', LEC = 'LEC', VEC = 'VEC')
coarse <- unname(lookup[reflab])
prediction <- predict_holdout(refM, coarse, split)
metrics <- reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, coarse[split$test])
write.csv(metrics, file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_endothelial_merged.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Endothelial annotation

```{r endothelial_annotation}

atlas <- list(expression = refM, labels = coarse, atlas_index = selected)

# cluster projection
expression <- LayerData(sub, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'data')
common <- intersect(rownames(expression), rownames(atlas$expression))
prediction <- SingleR(test = expression[common, ], ref = atlas$expression[common, ], labels = atlas$labels, clusters = sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8, fine.tune = TRUE)
lookup <- setNames(prediction$labels, rownames(prediction))
sub$Endothelial_label <- unname(lookup[as.character(sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8)])
sub$Endothelial_label[sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8 %in% c(6, 8)] <- 'HEC'
saveRDS(sub, file.path(intermediate_dir, 'endothelial_annotated.rds'))

```

### Fibroblast clustering

```{r fibroblast_clustering}

# fibroblast cells
sub <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$main_lineage == 'Fibroblast'])
features_use <- names(which(Matrix::rowMeans(LayerData(sub, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'counts') > 0) >= 0.05))

# PCA
sub <- RunPCA(sub, features = features_use, npcs = 30, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)

# clusters

```

### Fibroblast reference recovery

```{r fibroblast_reference_recovery}

# fibroblast recovery
subtypes <- c('Papil Fib', 'Retic Fib I', 'Retic Fib II', 'Retic Fib III', 'Perivasc Fib I', 'Perivasc Fib II', 'DP', 'DS')
selected <- which(atlas_labels %in% subtypes)
expression <- as.matrix(ref[, selected])
reflab <- atlas_labels[selected]
split <- reference_holdout(expression, reflab)
prediction <- predict_holdout(expression, reflab, split)
write.csv(reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, reflab[split$test]), file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_fibroblast.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

# merged fibroblast recovery
lookup <- c('DP' = 'DP', 'DS' = 'DS', 'Papil Fib' = 'Papil Fib', 'Perivasc Fib I' = 'Perivasc Fib', 'Perivasc Fib II' = 'Perivasc Fib', 'Retic Fib I' = 'Retic Fib', 'Retic Fib II' = 'Retic Fib', 'Retic Fib III' = 'Retic Fib')
coarse <- unname(lookup[reflab])
prediction <- predict_holdout(expression, coarse, split)
write.csv(reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, coarse[split$test]), file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_fibroblast_merged.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Fibroblast annotation

Merging related anatomical reference subtypes improved recovery but did not capture the functional and cancer-associated fibroblast states observed here. We therefore used marker-based cluster annotations rather than the atlas labels.

```{r fibroblast_annotation}

dictionary <- subtype_dictionary[subtype_dictionary$lineage == 'Fibroblast', ]

# manual annotation
lookup <- setNames(dictionary$label, as.character(dictionary$cluster))
sub$Fibroblast_label <- unname(lookup[as.character(sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8)])
saveRDS(sub, file.path(intermediate_dir, 'fibroblast_annotated.rds'))

```


### Lymphocyte reference recovery

```{r lymphocyte_reference_recovery}

# lymphocyte recovery
selected <- which(atlas_labels %in% c('CD8+ Tc', 'CD4+ Th', 'CD4+ Treg', 'Naïve T', 'Plasma'))
expression <- as.matrix(ref[, selected])
reflab <- atlas_labels[selected]
split <- reference_holdout(expression, reflab)
prediction <- predict_holdout(expression, reflab, split)
write.csv(reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, reflab[split$test]), file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_lymphocytes.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

# merged lymphocyte recovery
lookup <- c('CD8+ Tc' = 'T.CD8', 'CD4+ Th' = 'T.CD4', 'CD4+ Treg' = 'T.CD4', 'Plasma' = 'B.Lymphocyte', 'Naïve T' = 'T.Naive')
coarse <- unname(lookup[reflab])
prediction <- predict_holdout(expression, coarse, split)
metrics <- reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, coarse[split$test])
write.csv(metrics, file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_lymphocytes_merged.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Lymphocyte annotation

Reference recovery was insufficient, so lymphocyte subtypes were assigned from cluster markers, including T-cell, NK, B-cell and cycling programs. Cluster 13 was identified as fibroblasts from COL6A1/PDGFRA/CCL19 expression with little CD3E; its reassignment is completed in notebook 04.

```{r lymphocyte_annotation}

dictionary <- subtype_dictionary[subtype_dictionary$lineage == 'Lymphocyte', ]

# manual annotation
lookup <- setNames(dictionary$label, as.character(dictionary$cluster))
sub$lymphocyte_label <- unname(lookup[as.character(sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8)])
saveRDS(sub, file.path(intermediate_dir, 'lymphocyte_annotated.rds'))

```

```{r epithelial_clustering}
# epithelial cells
sub <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$main_lineage == 'Epithelial'])
features_use <- names(which(Matrix::rowMeans(LayerData(sub, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'counts') > 0) >= 0.05))
```

### Epithelial reference recovery

Similar spinous/granular keratinocyte, infundibulum and outer-root-sheath labels were merged to improve reference recovery. Transfer was then retained, with marker-based overrides for melanoma (cluster 16), cycling keratinocytes (22) and suprabasal keratinocytes (13).

```{r epithelial_reference_recovery}

# epithelial reference
subtypes <- c('Bas KC', 'Spn KC I', 'Spn KC II', 'Grn KC', 'Cyc KC', 'Bas Inf', 'Diff Inf', 'ORS Basal', 'ORS Suprabasal', 'IRS/HS', 'Bulge', 'Ecc Duct', 'Ecc Gland')
selected <- which(atlas_labels %in% subtypes)
reflab <- atlas_labels[selected]
refM <- as.matrix(ref[, selected])

# held-out cells
split <- reference_holdout(refM, reflab)
prediction <- predict_holdout(refM, reflab, split)
metrics <- reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, reflab[split$test])
write.csv(metrics, file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_epithelial.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

# merged epithelial labels
lookup <- c('Bas KC' = 'Bas KC', 'Bas Inf' = 'Infundibulum', 'Diff Inf' = 'Infundibulum', 'Cyc KC' = 'Cyc KC', 'Spn KC I' = 'Spn KC', 'Spn KC II' = 'Spn KC', 'Grn KC' = 'Spn KC', 'Bulge' = 'Bulge', 'ORS Basal' = 'ORS', 'ORS Suprabasal' = 'ORS', 'Ecc Duct' = 'Ecc Duct', 'Ecc Gland' = 'Ecc Gland', 'IRS/HS' = 'IRS')
coarse <- unname(lookup[reflab])
prediction <- predict_holdout(refM, coarse, split)
metrics <- reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, coarse[split$test])
write.csv(metrics, file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_epithelial_merged.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Epithelial annotation

```{r epithelial_annotation}

atlas <- list(expression = refM, labels = coarse, atlas_index = selected)

# cluster projection
expression <- LayerData(sub, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'data')
common <- intersect(rownames(expression), rownames(atlas$expression))
prediction <- SingleR(test = expression[common, ], ref = atlas$expression[common, ], labels = atlas$labels, clusters = sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8, aggr.ref = TRUE, fine.tune = TRUE)
lookup <- setNames(prediction$labels, rownames(prediction))
sub$Epithelial_label <- unname(lookup[as.character(sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8)])
sub$Epithelial_label[sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8 %in% 16] <- 'Melanoma'
sub$Epithelial_label[sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8 %in% 22] <- 'Cyc KC'
sub$Epithelial_label[sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8 %in% 13] <- 'Spn KC'
sub$Epithelial_label[sub$Epithelial_label == 'Spn KC'] <- 'Suprabasal KC'
saveRDS(sub, file.path(intermediate_dir, 'epithelial_annotated.rds'))

```

### Stroma clustering

```{r stroma_clustering}

# stromal cells
sub <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$main_lineage == 'Stroma'])
features_use <- names(which(Matrix::rowMeans(LayerData(sub, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'counts') > 0) >= 0.05))
features_use <- setdiff(features_use, 'C11orf96')

# PCA
sub <- RunPCA(sub, features = features_use, npcs = 30, seed.use = 42, verbose = FALSE)

# clusters
sub <- FindNeighbors(sub, dims = 1:5, verbose = FALSE)
sub <- FindClusters(sub, resolution = 0.8, algorithm = 1, random.seed = 0, verbose = FALSE)

```

### Stroma reference recovery

```{r stroma_reference_recovery}

# stromal recovery
selected <- which(atlas_labels %in% c('Peri', 'SM'))
expression <- as.matrix(ref[, selected])
reflab <- atlas_labels[selected]
split <- reference_holdout(expression, reflab)
prediction <- predict_holdout(expression, reflab, split)
write.csv(reference_recovery_metrics(prediction, reflab[split$test]), file.path(result_dir, 'celltype_recovery_stroma.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Stroma annotation

Reference recovery was insufficient, particularly for smooth muscle. Clusters were therefore annotated from pericyte markers (RGS5/NOTCH3) or smooth-muscle markers (MYH11/ACTA2/TAGLN/SYNPO2/MYL9).

```{r stroma_annotation}

dictionary <- subtype_dictionary[subtype_dictionary$lineage == 'Stroma', ]

# manual annotation
lookup <- setNames(dictionary$label, as.character(dictionary$cluster))
sub$Stroma_label <- unname(lookup[as.character(sub$Xenium_snn_res.0.8)])
saveRDS(sub, file.path(intermediate_dir, 'stroma_annotated.rds'))

```
